title.zh: Kalshi将支持加密资产抵押借款用于永续期货保证金
title.en: Kalshi将支持加密资产抵押借款用于永续期货保证金

current_state.zh: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.

updates.title_zh: Kalshi将支持加密资产抵押借款用于永续期货保证金
updates.title_en: Kalshi将支持加密资产抵押借款用于永续期货保证金
updates.what_changed_zh:
Kalshi 与加密资产托管机构 BitGo 达成协议，将允许其在美国注册的期货佣金商 Kalshi Prime 的客户以托管的数字资产作为抵押借款，并把贷款资金用作 Kalshi 交易所杠杆永续期货交易的保证金。据彭博社报道，该安排采用三方抵押品管理结构，贷款由 Kalshi 关联借贷公司 Kalshi Katalyst 提供，抵押资产存放于 BitGo Bank & Trust。

Kalshi Prime 首席执行官 Jeff Bandman 表示，该安排旨在让客户无需退出加密资产持仓即可参与交易，并可能吸引加密原生交易机构及持有大量数字资产的巨鲸。

合格抵押资产包括比特币、以太坊，以及被视为符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，预计后续还将接入其他托管机构。Kalshi 今年早些时候已推出黄金、白银及加密货币永续合约，并已申请推出与石油和美股挂钩的永续类产品。
updates.what_changed_en: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.
updates.background_zh: Kalshi Prime 是美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的期货佣金商，为衍生品和事件类金融产品提供执行、清算和主经纪商服务；Kalshi 于今年 6 月推出该实体，并于 8 月 12 日任命 CFTC 清算与风险部前负责人 Jeff Bandman 为首席执行官。《GENIUS 法案》是美国联邦层面的稳定币立法，规定了合规支付稳定币的发行要求，OCC 与财政部等监管机构正在陆续出台实施细则。
updates.background_en: Kalshi Prime is a US futures commission merchant regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission that provides execution, clearing and prime brokerage services for derivatives and event-based financial products; Kalshi launched it in June and appointed former CFTC Division of Clearing and Risk head Jeff Bandman as CEO on 12 August. The GENIUS Act is the US federal stablecoin statute governing permitted payment stablecoin issuance, and regulators including the OCC and Treasury have been issuing implementing rules.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是杠杆与抵押品流动性：存放于 BitGo 的加密资产如今无需卖出即可为 CFTC 监管场所的保证金提供支持，这可能降低机构持有者为衍生品敞口而清算现货的需求。明确纳入符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，则把保证金基础与受监管稳定币范畴绑定；不过该安排仅面向 Kalshi Prime 客户，规模上尚不具系统性。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is leverage and collateral mobility: crypto held at BitGo can now back margin on a CFTC-regulated venue without being sold, which may reduce the need for institutional holders to liquidate spot positions to fund derivatives exposure. The explicit inclusion of GENIUS-compliant stablecoins ties the margin base to the regulated stablecoin perimeter, though the facility is limited to Kalshi Prime clients and is not systemic in scale.
